name: Agent Improver
tagline: Tunes one of your Grok Bots so it stays useful after the first week
description: A tuner for a Grok Bot you already run. Paste the bot, describe the misses, and it rewrites instructions, tightens tools and proposes a short test plan so the bot keeps earning its keep after week one instead of drifting into noise.
author: stevenvillarino
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
